title: SAPH.Ai Secures Industry Collaboration to Scale Water Innovation
summary: SAPH.Ai announced a strategic collaboration with a leading local water purification company to scale water quality technologies.
description: At SAPH.Ai, we believe innovation only matters when it reaches the communities that need it most. We are excited to announce a strategic collaboration with a leading local water purification and distribution company to scale our water quality monitoring and purification technologies.

Through this partnership, SAPH.Ai will gain valuable industry expertise in large-scale water purification, quality assurance and testing, manufacturing, supply chain operations, and sustainable distribution systems. This collaboration will help accelerate the transition of our research from prototype to real-world impact.

Our immediate focus remains on the coastal communities of Bagerhat. Building on our pilot deployments across 20 villages, this partnership provides the industrial infrastructure and operational support needed to expand proven solutions to a larger scale. By combining SAPH.Ai’s monitoring technology with our partner’s purification and distribution capabilities, we aim to make safe, clean drinking water accessible to thousands of families facing water scarcity.
From research and innovation to deployment and impact, SAPH.Ai remains committed to developing scalable, affordable, and practical solutions for the water sector.

title: Robovision Workshop at Sabujbagh Government College
summary: SAPH.Ai conducted a 'Robovision' workshop for 100 high school participants at Sabujbagh Government College.
description: SAPH.Ai recently conducted a workshop “Robovision” at Sabujbagh Government College in Dhaka. Organized by the Sabujbagh Government College Science Club, the event successfully hosted 100 high school participants.

The session was led by Abrar Abir, Emtenan Kabir, and Hridoy Howlader. Together, they guided the participants through a comprehensive presentation focused on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Tech Awareness.
The workshop incorporated interactive quizzes. Upon conclusion, the organizers awarded gifts to recognize student participation and encourage continued interest.

title: Build Your Own Robots Your Robot Your Rules
summary: SAPH.Ai & Frequency Lab organized a two-day workshop offering practical technology learning to students in grades 4 to 10.
description: SAPH.Ai & Frequency Lab recently collaborated to organize a two day workshop titled Build Your Own Robots Your Robot Your Rules at Shopnonagar Residential Area 1 in Dhaka. The free event took place on Friday and Saturday January 30 and 31 offering students of grades 4 to 10 a practical learning experience in technology.

During the program Emtenan Kabir Co-founder and CTO of SAPH.Ai took a handheld session on AI robotics and awareness. This provided the young participants with direct guidance and foundational knowledge in modern robotics and artificial intelligence.

title: AI and Robotics Workshop in Bagerhat
summary: SAPH.Ai founder Abrar Abir hosted a dynamic workshop at Bagerhat Govt. High School for 200 participants from 5 local schools.
description: SAPH.Ai recently brought the excitement of AI and robotics to Bagerhat! Our founder, Abrar Abir, hosted a dynamic workshop at Bagerhat Govt. High School, engaging a fantastic group of 200 participants from 5 local schools.

The session highlighted how technology isn't just for coding—it's a powerful tool for solving real-world challenges, especially in areas like sanitation and climate resilience. As a youth-driven organization, SAPH.Ai is dedicated to empowering the next generation to innovate and build sustainable solutions that create lasting positive impact in their communities. We were thrilled to see such enthusiasm from the students!

title: Robotics Workshop at Govt. Laboratory High School
summary: SAPH.Ai introduced nearly 100 participants to robotics and AI fundamentals in Rajshahi.
description: SAPH.Ai recently conducted a workshop in Rajshahi at the Govt. Laboratory High School, where nearly 100 participants were introduced to the fundamentals of robotics and artificial intelligence. The session emphasized how technology can play a vital role in addressing real-world challenges in sanitation, water management, and climate resilience.

As a youth-driven robotics organization, SAPH.Ai is committed to revolutionizing sanitation through AI-powered robotics while engaging communities to raise awareness on sustainable practices. Our mission combines innovation with social responsibility, inspiring young people to build solutions that create lasting impact.

During the workshop, we shared insights from our initial projects, including the development of robotic systems for drainage cleaning and water monitoring. These experiences demonstrated how innovation grows from problem identification to practical implementation, motivating participants to envision their role in fostering a cleaner and more resilient future.

title: AI & Robotics Seminar at Dhaka University
summary: SAPH.Ai founder Abrar Abir conducted an AI & Robotics seminar organized by Kamol Medi Aid, DU.
description: SAPH.Ai founder Abrar Abir recently conducted a seminar on AI & Robotics at Dhaka University, organized by Kamol Medi Aid, DU at RC Majumdar Auditorium.
From teaching beginner-level robotics and AI to showcasing internationally recognized water & sanitation projects, Abrar Abir also proposed innovative solutions tailored for DU’s campus and halls.

Big thanks to Shaikh Tanvir Baree Hamim and Kamol Medi Aid, DU for organizing this impactful session. Grateful for the presence of DU Professors, Authority, Student Leaders, and Students who made the seminar even more engaging.
